# halos_me (Data Source)

The identity the provider authenticates as (GET /api/v1/me): use it to assert that the credential has the roles a configuration needs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "halos_me" "this" {}

# Fail the plan early if the credential cannot administer tokens.
check "provider_can_admin" {
  assert {
    condition     = contains(data.halos_me.this.permissions, "admin")
    error_message = "the Halos credential lacks the admin permission"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `admin` (Boolean) Whether the caller holds the admin permission globally.
- `groups` (List of String) Directory groups.
- `id` (String) The caller's id, for a service token `service-account:<name>:<id>`.
- `kind` (String) Empty for a signed-in user, `service-account` for a token.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permissions the roles grant: read, operate, approve, audit, admin.
- `ring` (String) The ring policy assigns the caller to.
- `roles` (List of String) Role names granted to the caller.
